s: E-LANE E-7 walk_e7_nokv: one-kick chain, the norm's gamma FETCHED from card DRAM

E-LANE E-7 chain walk_e7_nokv: ONE fmt=1 walk, ONE KICK = SCORE + PV + FUEL-FED OPROJ EPILOGUE + RES1 + NFEED + NORM2 with the GAMMA FETCHED FROM CARD DRAM by the walker's own record (toy 64, H=1, T=1). The norm eats the epilogue's own r1 AND a weight the walker fetched; its output drains through the walker-armed y path into act bank 1 row 2. Host in the walk window: NOTHING.
phase A: CSR sanity + illegal-descriptor reject + tier init
INFO_TIER expect retargeted 0x7->0x1 (image b64_05b: KVQ_OUTLIER_K=0, KVQ_GQA_NENG=2 -> CQ-8-only; apex_top.sv:2540-2543). Jobs are CQ-8; NO datapath expectation touched.
loader token: h8=[127,1,0...] via real RMSNorm+feeder
[1] host loads (walk_e6's exact staging): phase-q; K/V; X; o-act family at bank1 row 1; pre-staged rotated q at row 0.
FUELARM-SPLICE-POINT
IB-FUEL arm: mode only (src=1, ar_owner=1). The walker issues the records itself.
[2] the 64-word image: E6C_MASK + {NORM2, FGAM} + the Wo AND g2 tensor bases — the gamma is a fetched tensor now

[3] THE ONE KICK — attention, epilogue, NFEED, gamma fetch, norm, y-drain, all under one done-poll. No xw pacing, no RO drain, no gamma stream: the fs FIFO (12 beats total) holds everything until the post-walk drain.

FUELDISARM-SPLICE-POINT
IB-FUEL disarm: src back to MAILBOX (reader idle, FIFO empty — the walk consumed its records whole)
consumers drained CLEAN; no LAYER error
[3b] the level word the WALKER left — NFEED's code-4/nsrc=1 were RE-ARMED by the y-drain (S2_GDL: fsrc_ext=0, nsrc=0), so this full-word check PROVES the walker ran the drain arm
[4] drain the walk's egress in FIFO order: 1 ss (s_c), 11 fs (s_k, 8x s_v, the NFEED r1 scale, the Y-DRAIN h2 scale), 8 RO beats (the PV o8), the TIP beat
[5] NO host gamma, NO host drain jobs — the walk already normalized and drained. Read the h2 codes back from act bank1 ROW 2 (the walker's fp_top window) via identity GEMMs, then the r1 row.
quiescence + LAYER error accounting (no unit may have refused: LAYER_STATUS[8] sticky must be clear)
final: quiescence + sticky accounting + PERF + F-3 clear
